# tissue_mast_override (Resource)

A stretch of time when someone else holds a rotation: a swap, or cover for a holiday. Times are local to the rotation's `tz`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Ben covers Ana from Christmas Eve through Boxing Day.
resource "tissue_mast_override" "holiday" {
  rotation_id    = tissue_mast_rotation.primary.id
  user_id        = data.tissue_mast_person.ben.user_id
  covers_user_id = data.tissue_mast_person.ana.user_id
  start          = "2026-12-24"
  end            = "2026-12-26"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end` (String) A date, meaning the end of that day, or a time, where the override hands back. Two dates cover whole days, both included.
- `rotation_id` (String) The rotation this override belongs to.
- `start` (String) A date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, meaning 00:00 that day, or a time, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`.
- `user_id` (String) Who is on call instead.

### Optional

- `covers_user_id` (String) Only stand in for this person. Without it the override takes every shift it overlaps.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<rotation_id>/<override_id>`.
- `override_id` (String) The override's own id, `ov_...`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <rotation id or name>/<override id>
terraform import tissue_mast_override.holiday primary/ov_51c7a3e0d2b94f18
```
